name: Camporredondo (Spain)
description: Red field within a blue border charged with twelve white stars, charged at the centre with two white eradicated pines.
history: The municipal flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a red cloth with two white eradicated pines placed in fess, with a blue border of a seventh of the length of the flag charged with twelve white five-pointed stars, five in the upper and lower parts, one at the hoist and one at the fly.
